title: Discover outcomes and preview an explicit batch
preconditions: The evaluation is retained and completed; the caller has the trusted owner actor context; the public CLASSIFY schemas are discoverable; any continuation belongs to the same evaluation, filters, page size, and fingerprint.
postconditions: Every returned row is deterministically ordered and attributable to the retained evaluation; the selected preview is frozen and idempotent; no Ledger mutation occurs before an explicit apply.run; broadApplyAllowed=false never authorizes unattended or implicit bulk mutation.
main_flow: The caller invokes classify.outcome.list with an evaluation ID and bounded filters; follows the opaque continuation until the required rows are available; invokes classify.outcome.get only when deeper single-row evidence is needed; selects exact returned outcome IDs; and sends those IDs in the existing selected_outcomes mode to classify.apply.preview before any optional classify.apply.run.
alt_flows: Reject a malformed, expired, cross-evaluation, cross-filter, cross-page-size, or fingerprint-mismatched cursor with a typed error and no partial page.
Reject an expired or missing evaluation, stale Ledger generation, archived suggested category, missing active rule set, or integrity mismatch without a partial result or mutation.
Reject oversized pages or selected batches before preview durability and preserve the existing explicit-selection boundary.
